title: Words Worth Their Weight in Mora
description: The recent crisis that beset Liyue Harbor has reinvigorated interest in history. Wanwen Bookhouse has seen a resurgence in business as a result, and its owner Jifang is on the verge of being overwhelmed...

dialogs.text: What is it, youngster?
Here's the order you placed with Jifang.
The fourth volume of Rex Incognito? I placed this order eons ago. Why has it tarried till now?
Let me see. Huh? A first edition? Why, no wonder it took so long...
To think I'd assumed that Jifang had forgotten about my book amid all the other customers...
Thank you for delivering this book to me, youngster.
What can I do for you, youngster?
Here's the order you placed with Jifang.
The what now? ...Oh, ah yes. I believe I ordered a copy of the Verses of Equilibrium at the Wanwen Bookhouse.
Indeed, indeed, this is the book that I wanted. Haha, I was beginning to think that Jifang might have forgotten about my order, what with the other customers and all...
But it's here now, and that's good. The binding is fairly good as well. Conscientious as always, that Jifang.
Thank you, youngster. I'll take this with me, now.
So, about those two books...
The two of them are long-time customers of ours. I usually prepare their books beforehand.
But I ended up dragging my feet a little this time due to the surge in business.
They must have gotten impatient...

Have you delivered them?
Yes, I have.
Thank you. Wanwen Bookhouse has managed to stay open all this time due to the support of our long-time customers.
What's more, these customers are true lovers of books. It should gladden them greatly to receive good ones.
Thanks so much for your help, Traveler. Please take this as compensation for your efforts.
If you should ever wish to purchase any books, feel free to approach me.
